demos.name: Intent, Purpose and Behaviour Lab
demos.description: Three signals asked of every call (intent, purpose, behaviour), plus on-behalf-of and ID-JAG token flows, as a simulation of the 2026-11-02 Ping release claims. Mock tables, or a Live local engine with real RS256 signing. Every product claim is UNVERIFIED on our tenant.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7100). Docker: HOST_PORT=7100 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock and Live are both loopback-only with zero outbound calls. No catalog id yet. Sibling lab for the standalone ID-JAG walkthrough: id-jag-standalone-LAB (never imported).
